description: Change a video here: cut, join, film a Production, reframe, grade, speed, caption, mix, continue or remake it.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with video on; this chat already holds a finished video (a cut, a join or a voice or song over it needs only the video editor on this computer)

author: MaiPai

examples: try that again with a slow camera move
add some music to the video
keep going from where it ended
make my production Summer at the Lake into a movie

clip.description: Which video: "latest" for the newest one in this chat, or a video id. Required for every change except film.

change.description: another_take makes the same video again with a new random result. remix makes it again with changes. make_it_max makes it at Max for people an admin allowed. trim cuts it; set from_s and to_s. join puts your videos in order; set clips. mix adds a voice or song; to add new music made for the video, use sound music with make_music. cut_to_beat cuts your videos to the beat of your song; set track, clips, beats_per_cut (1, 2, 4 or 8, default 4) and length_s (5 to 60, default 30). reframe changes shape; grade changes the look; film_look applies a preset; letterbox adds cinema bars; speed changes playback; captions adds timed words. upscale: make the clip sharper and twice as big. remove_background cuts out the main subject. title_card adds a title at the start; credits adds rolling names at the end. continue starts from its last picture. extend makes it longer at Max; set seconds to how many more seconds. retake makes it again from a time at Max; set from_s and prompt only if the words change. These make a new version and keep the first. A video exists only if you called this tool in this reply. film turns a Production into a movie; set production and leave clip out.

prompt.description: For remix and continue, or retake: the new full description of the video, when the person changed what it shows or says what happens next. A line a person says goes in quotes, one person speaking at a time. Cartoon characters should be named and described with their era and animation style.

look.description: For remix and continue: a video look. For join or film: one of the film look presets.

camera.description: For remix and continue: a new camera move or style, when the person asks for one.

voices.description: For remix and continue: clean means no laugh track and no music; full adds music and sound effects. Use full only when the person asks for music or effects.

tier.description: For remix and continue: a new level, when the person asks for more or less quality. Max is for people an admin allowed.

seconds.description: For remix and continue: a new length in seconds. For extend: how many more seconds to add, within this computer’s range. Max is required.

keep_seed.description: For remix only: true when the person wants the same result with the change, as close to the first as possible. Leave it out otherwise.

from_s.description: For trim: where the kept part starts. For retake: the start time in seconds, within this computer’s range. Max is required.

to_s.description: For trim only: where the kept part ends, in seconds from the start. "Cut the first two seconds" is from_s 2 with to_s left out; "keep the first four seconds" is to_s 4.

clips.description: For join only: 2 to 6 of the person's own videos in the order they want them, each a video id or "latest". Only videos made by this person.

sound.description: For mix only: voice lays a spoken line over the video (set line); music lays one of the person's own songs or sound files (set track).

line.description: For mix with voice: the exact words to say, as the person typed or dictated them. A line of about 12 words fits 5 seconds.

voice.description: For mix with voice: the name of one of this home's voices when the person names one. Leave it out to use the person's own voice.

track.description: For mix with music: the id of the person's own song (a music job) or sound file in their Library.

make_music.description: For mix with music, when the person wants new music made for the video instead of one of their songs: a short description of the music (mood, instruments, pace). Home makes an instrumental the length of the video first, then lays it under the video. Leave track out.

level.description: For mix only: how loud the new sound is against the video's own sound, from quiet to very_loud. Leave it out for the default: a voice over a lowered video sound, a song softly under it.

start_s.description: For mix only: seconds into the video where the new sound starts. Leave it out to start at the beginning.

transition.description: For join or film: the transition between videos. dissolve is a smooth blend; speckle is grainy. Film uses a fade by default; join uses a straight cut.

transition_s.description: For join or film with a transition: how long it lasts in seconds, from 0.3 to 1. Leave it out for half a second.

title.description: For join or title_card: title text. A film uses its Production title.

subtitle.description: For a title card. A film uses its Production summary.

credits.description: For join or credits: names and optional roles for rolling credits. A film uses its Production cast.

credits_title.description: Optional heading above the rolling credits. Set only when the person asks for one.

styles.description: Optional, for another_take, remix and continue. The names of up to two of the person's saved video styles, only when the person names one; an empty list takes the style off. Left out, the new video keeps the first one's style. Never invent a name.

strength.description: Optional. Style strength (less, normal or more) or film look strength from 0.2 to 1.

aspect.description: For reframe: the video's new shape.

background.description: What goes behind the person or thing that stays: a color, a blur, or see-through. Use black, white, green, blur, transparent or a six-digit hex color.

fill.description: For reframe: crop to fill (default) or blur the empty edges.

warmth.description: For grade: warmth from cool to warm; set only when asked.

brightness.description: For grade: brightness; set only when asked.

contrast.description: For grade: contrast; set only when asked.

saturation.description: For grade: saturation; set only when asked.

grain.description: For grade: film grain amount; set only when asked.

vignette.description: For grade: vignette amount; set only when asked.

factor.description: For speed: playback speed from 0.25 to 4; use 0.5 for half speed and 2 for double.

captions.description: For captions: exact caption text and its start and end times, up to 40 lines.

position.description: For captions: where the words appear; bottom by default.

production.description: For film: the Production id or its exact title, when that title is unique among productions you can see.

preset.description: For film_look: the film look preset to apply.

ratio.description: For letterbox: the cinema frame ratio.

letterbox.description: Optional for join or film: add cinema bars at this frame ratio.

effect.description: For effect: the finishing effect to apply to the existing video. kenburns adds a zoom and pan to that clip.

amount.description: For sharpen or denoise: amount from 0 to 1.

times.description: For loop: total plays, from 2 to 6.

fps.description: For fps_boost: smooth the clip to 30, 48 or 60 frames per second.

direction.description: For flip: direction. For kenburns, horizontal moves right and vertical moves down.

from_factor.description: For speed_ramp: starting speed. For kenburns: starting zoom from 1 to 2.

to_factor.description: For speed_ramp: ending speed. For kenburns: ending zoom from 1 to 2.

at_s.description: For speed_ramp: where it starts. For freeze: the frame time, in seconds.

over_s.description: For speed_ramp: ramp duration from 0.3 to 10 seconds.

hold_s.description: For freeze: how long to hold the frame, from 0.5 to 5 seconds.

corner.description: For pip: which corner holds the other video.

size.description: For pip: size of the small video, from 0.15 to 0.5.

with_clip.description: For pip: id or latest for a second video to show in the corner.
